title: Seetharamam
desc: Afreen, a Pakistani woman, heads to India in order to deliver a love letter written in 1965 to fulfill her grandfather's dying wish. However, the journey alters her life forever.

title: Kollura Sri Mookambika
desc: Kaumasura, a demon, persistently troubles Kola Maharishi during his meditation. When Kola Maharishi prays to Goddess Parvati for deliverance, she incarnates as Mookambika to vanquish the demon.

title: Mirchi
desc: Manasa falls in love with Jai after he helps her and manages to win the hearts of her family with his good deeds. However, she is unaware that he belongs to a rival family.

title: Love Birds
desc: Mridula relocates to the UK to nurse her broken heart after her lover Arun dies. However, when she meets a man who looks exactly like him, she tries to find his true identity.

title: Adipurush
desc: The exiled prince Raghav embarks on a perilous journey to rescue his wife, Janaki, from the clutches of the demon king Lankesh. He must gather an army to wage an epic battle against evil forces.

title: Advocate
desc: Three girls who escape molestation but are charged with murder must prove their innocence with the help of a lawyer who is an alcoholic.

title: Bhaagamathie
desc: Chanchala, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

title: Kiragoorina Gayyaligalu
desc: A village living in harmony faces challenges when politicians try to divide the people based on caste. Subsequently, female villagers take up the task of fighting the oppressors.
